title: Konstera Standard Context Pack v1
description: The canonical vocabulary of context names (glossary terms, skills, ontology entities) that every Konstera-managed seed pack guarantees. Third-party agents declare contextRequirements against these names knowing a tenant that forked the retail-core (or future) seed will have them. The SDK packages (Konstera.Sdk.Contexts NuGet + konstera_sdk_contexts PyPI) emit these names as typed constants so agent authors catch typos at build time, not at install.

refund_window_days.description: Number of days from delivery during which a return is accepted at full value under the standard policy.

vip_tier_exception.description: Policy clause that extends refund_window_days for customers in a VIP tier and may waive restocking_fee.

limited_edition_restocking_fee.description: Percentage deducted from refund_amount when the returned SKU is limited_edition. Default 15%.

chargeback_filed.description: Boolean on a ticket indicating the customer has initiated a chargeback dispute with their card issuer. Blocks the refund path.

return_reason_code.description: Enum reason the customer gave for the return: size | changed_mind | wrong_item | not_as_described | damaged | quality | late_delivery | other.

fulfilment_status.description: Current state of an order_line in the pick-pack-ship-deliver lifecycle: pending | picked | packed | shipped | out_for_delivery | delivered | failed.

fcr.description: First-contact resolution rate — share of tickets resolved on the first customer interaction.

aht.description: Average handle time per ticket, including hold + after-call work.

deflection_rate.description: Share of inquiries resolved without human agent contact. Measures self-service effectiveness.

markdown_rate.description: realised-markdown-dollars ÷ gross-sales-dollars. The canonical merchandising KPI for discount depth.

sell_through.description: Units sold ÷ units received, measured over a season or window.

gmroi.description: Gross margin return on inventory investment — gross margin ÷ average inventory cost.

promo_cannibalisation.description: Degree to which a promotional discount shifts sales within the catalog without generating incremental revenue.

otb.description: Open-to-buy — planned receipts budget available for the balance of a period.

safety_stock.description: Buffer inventory held to cover demand variability + supplier lead-time variance.

days_cover.description: Number of days of expected sell-through covered by current on-hand inventory.

delivery_sla.description: Contracted delivery service-level agreement — ship-to-doorstep in days by delivery_tier.

vip_tier.description: Loyalty tier assigned to a customer: silver | gold | platinum, with escalating policy exceptions.

ltv.description: Customer lifetime value — predicted total revenue a customer generates over their relationship.

cac.description: Customer acquisition cost — blended cost to acquire a new paying customer.

revenue.description: GAAP revenue excluding returns, net of discounts. The authoritative top-line figure.

cogs.description: Cost of goods sold — landed cost of the units that generated the revenue in the period.

evaluate_refund_eligibility.description: Deterministic 6-step playbook for refund-eligibility decisioning: enrichment → window check (with VIP exception) → limited-edition fee + chargeback escalation → refund_amount compute → approve-with-confidence. Shipped reference implementation on the customer-service-agent.

diagnose_markdown_spike.description: Four-step playbook for markdown-rate spike diagnosis: seasonality → competitor pricing → stock aging → promo cannibalisation. M14 pilot (Scenario 1 of ADR-037).

customer.description: A person or organisation with a persistent identity in the tenant's commerce system.

order.description: A customer's purchase, composed of one or more order_line entities.

order_line.description: One SKU + quantity within an order; the finest refund + fulfilment granularity.

fulfilment.description: The physical act of picking + packing + shipping an order_line.

return.description: A customer-initiated reversal of a delivered order_line.

refund.description: The money motion back to the customer following an approved return.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit — the finest sellable product variant.

product.description: A parent product grouping one-or-more SKU variants (size, colour).

variant.description: A specific size/colour/material combination of a product; typically a 1:1 with SKU.

category.description: A taxonomic grouping of products (menswear → outerwear → jackets).

brand.description: A product's brand of record — own-brand or licensed/third-party.

season.description: The merchandising season (SS26, AW25) a product collection belongs to.

collection.description: A product grouping curated by the merchandising team — e.g. 'Linen 2026'.

supplier.description: A vendor the business places purchase orders against.

purchase_order.description: Konstera's record of goods on order from a supplier.

shipment.description: An inbound shipment of purchased goods from a supplier.

stock_on_hand.description: Current on-hand inventory in units, by SKU × location.

available_to_promise.description: On-hand + inbound - allocated inventory; the committable quantity.

ticket.description: A customer-service inquiry recorded in the ticketing system.

chargeback.description: A card-issuer-initiated dispute against a settled transaction.

vip_tier_level.description: Named loyalty tier (silver / gold / platinum) attached to a customer.

channel.description: The sales channel for an order: web / mobile / store / marketplace / wholesale.

region.description: A geographic region used for merchandising + reporting splits.
